summary: Model estimate (route 3, best-knowledge delta): conservative state. Worse than national in one documented respect: on 23 February 2017 in the state capital, a 27-year-old transgender worker was stabbed and shot dead, and the state police CID chief said officers had "found no element of hate crime" while instead investigating the victim's own past - a victim-as-suspect response publicly condemned by a human-rights organisation. Scored relative to the national score (0.16) for Malaysia.
